security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Design test reports; render PDFs offline from LabVIEW and any language.
bundle.longDescription: Report Builder designs data-driven test reports and renders them to PDF with an embedded typesetting engine: no browser, no network. Includes the report-cli command-line tool and the reportbuilder library for LabVIEW.
